description.value: Afterthoughts is a family-owned gourmet dessert restaurant and café that has been baking in-house since 1994, known for cheesecakes, pies, cakes, and rotating seasonal treats made entirely from scratch on-site. Beyond desserts, it serves freshly made sandwiches, wraps, salads, soups, and quiches alongside specialty café beverages featuring locally roasted coffee. The modern space at Central Park Village in Abbotsford features a heated patio and a private party and meeting room.
